articles.title: Coinbase-backed Stand With Crypto calls on members to campaign against banks blocking digital asset transactions
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto UK is telling its members to file formal complaints with high-street banks over sector-wide transfer bans.

articles.title: Mastercard prepares for a future where AI agents make payments
articles.snippet: The company is working with Coinbase, Stripe and other companies to build trusted payment systems for AI-driven commerce.

articles.title: Anchorage backs Treasury’s GENIUS AML rules, seeks secondary-market sanctions clarity
articles.snippet: A public comment letter argues that regulated stablecoin issuers need clearer compliance standards to avoid sanctions risks tied to secondary-market activity.

articles.title: Bitcoin price may slide toward $30K as institutions dump 450% of daily BTC supply
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s institutional support weakened as ETFs and companies dumped almost 2,000 BTC daily and Strategy’s buying lost momentum.

articles.title: Blockchain researchers warn HTX sanctions may blur crypto risk signals
articles.snippet: Researchers say broad HTX tainting could freeze legitimate users and make compliance tools less useful for tracing illicit funds.
